**Finding: Compliant** (GOVLAW — Governing law and venue)

The governing-law package at §28 sits squarely at the **preferred** position:

- **§28.1** — Laws of the State of New York, conflict-of-laws excluded, CISG disclaimed.
- **§28.2** — Exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, with irrevocable submission to personal jurisdiction and waiver of venue/inconvenient-forum objections.
- **No arbitration** — a document-wide search for "arbitration" returned no results, so there is no foreign-seated arbitration exposure.

Two ancillary mechanics were reviewed and are unobjectionable: the §28.2 carve-out allowing either party to seek temporary injunctive relief in another competent court to protect confidential information or IP, and the §28.3 pre-suit executive escalation. Both are mutual, and §28.3 expressly does not delay urgent relief or a filing needed to preserve a limitations period — so it cannot be used to run our clock. Neither displaces the New York forum.

No redline proposed.
